It's  never  been  easier  to  start  a 
 business.  It's  also  never  been  easier  to 
 do  nothing.  People  are  just  distracted. 
 There's  hundreds  of  billions  of  dollars 
 that  are  getting  pumped  at  us  to 
 distract  us.  And  so,  you  have  to  have 
 some  level  of  basic  ability  to  focus  to 
 say,  "I'm  not  going  to  watch  Netflix. 
 I'm  not  going  to  watch  these  sports 
 games.  I'm  not  going  to  scroll  on  social 
 media  for  8  hours  a  day.  I'm  going  to 
 reach  out  to  people."  And  so,  like  first 
 level  is  you  can  actually  do  something. 
 And  then  the  second  one  is  when  you

 rejected  or  having  things  not  work  out
